info.title: Sports Photo Gallery — Local Owner API
info.description: Proposed versioned contract for the private desktop owner manager. Express binds 127.0.0.1:5000; the same-origin local frontend proxies /api and /media. All manager reads and writes are private, except the guarded local session bootstrap which does not require its own bearer token. Public hosting serves static manifests and immutable photo assets only, not this API, tokens, drafts, database, or raw EXIF. This specification is a contract review, not proof that concurrent implementation satisfies it. The unpublished, unversioned prototype is replaced; no external clients have been verified.

servers.description: Loopback-only owner manager. HTTP is an intentional local-only exception; never bind to a public/LAN interface or deploy this server.

x-local-security.strictOriginGuard: Every route, including session and reads, checks the socket peer and exact allowed Host. Origin, when supplied, must exactly match a configured local manager origin; reject null/foreign Origin and cross-site fetch contexts. Missing Origin on a browser same-origin GET is not automatically foreign: require an explicit, constrained same-origin/bootstrap policy. Never trust arbitrary forwarded headers to establish local ownership.
x-local-security.sessionBootstrap: The local manager operator is the owner; this is not account login. GET session is bearer-exempt but loopback/Host/origin guarded, returns the process-local token, and is no-store. Token remains in frontend memory, never in public output.
x-local-security.managerReads: All manager gallery/photo reads require OwnerBearer. Guarded session bootstrap is the only documented bearer exception.
x-local-security.deployment: No API is included in public static hosting. This local trust model does not protect against malware or another user/process already controlling the owner computer.

get.description: Bearer-exempt bootstrap, not public login. strictOriginGuard still enforces loopback peer, allowed Host and configured local-origin/fetch policy. A response is usable only by the owner manager frontend. No static public build makes this request.

get.summary: List all owner photos in one album
get.description: Return the complete album metadata array, including private draft additions, in chronological order defined by the implementation. Do not insert another photo’s capture date as fallback. No pagination in v1: the public frontend fetches and caches one static album manifest and initially renders a 36-photo window; that DOM window is not server pagination. Public visitors GET /data/albums/{id}.json, restricted to the last deliberate publication snapshot.

200.description: Complete album photo metadata array; an empty album is [].

Cache-Control.description: Local-owner JSON is private and not shared-cacheable. Required value: no-store.

get.x-pagination-exception: Full-album metadata is intentional; public manifest cached per album, initial frontend render window 36. Reassess using measured large-album manifest size/parse cost.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Stable gallery identifier, URL encoded by the client.

post.summary: Record a deliberate album publication snapshot
post.description: After explicit original-quality/public metadata acknowledgement, record the current photo IDs as the public snapshot and return the gallery. This prepares data for a later export; it does not deploy or make the local API reachable. Newly uploaded photos remain draft until another publication.

Cache-Control.description: Local-owner JSON is private and not shared-cacheable. Required value: no-store.

post.summary: Prepare one original photo as an album draft
post.description: Accept exactly one multipart field named photo, preserve the original byte-for-byte, detect per-image metadata and create display derivatives locally before returning the saved photo. Decoder allowlist: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF; first frame only. SVG, GIF, HEIC and RAW are unsupported. Limit original to 100 MiB. No public publication is triggered. Batch handling is bounded in the desktop client. Cancellation/lost responses may leave a completed saved photo; check album before retrying. No Idempotency-Key or automatic deduplication is promised.

201.description: Saved draft photo after local preparation.

Cache-Control.description: Local-owner JSON is private and not shared-cacheable. Required value: no-store.

requestBody.description: Exactly one original plus per-file metadata fields. Multipart content overhead is separate from the per-file limit.

post.summary: Inspect one image without storing a photo
post.description: Transient owner-only image metadata inspection for pre-upload review. No persistent upload or database photo record. Same supported decoder formats and 100 MiB file limit as photo preparation. GPS detection is a warning, not a complete automated privacy review.

Cache-Control.description: Local-owner JSON is private and not shared-cacheable. Required value: no-store.

requestBody.description: Single inspection file and optional last-modified fallback.

post.summary: Prepare the published static website locally
post.description: Build an output directory containing frontend assets, public album manifests and only deliberately published immutable photo IDs. Exclude owner token, database, draft images and raw EXIF JSON; original files still contain their unchanged embedded EXIF. Reject, do not silently shrink/skip, any original over 25 MiB (26,214,400 bytes) or complete output over 20,000 files. Return only after export completion; copying a retained archive may be slow. This synchronous v1 contract has no job polling or remote deployment. Missing public frontend build is 503. Existing public deployment is unaffected by a local failure.

requestBody.description: Empty object; prepares files but never deploys them.

OwnerBearer.description: Opaque owner token issued only by guarded GET /api/v1/session; not a JWT, OAuth token, viewer credential, or public API key. Required for all other manager operations. Re-bootstrap after token invalidation/restart.

Error.description: All application JSON errors share this envelope. Do not expose stacks, SQL, tokens or raw metadata.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code; clients must tolerate future codes.

error.description: Actionable machine code and human message; no internal diagnostics.

error.message: Choose an existing gallery before uploading.

token.description: Opaque bearer secret. Never log, cache publicly, or export.

eventDate.description: Owner-provided album date. ISO 8601 date or date-time; EXIF has no reliable timezone when none was recorded.

themePreset.description: Preset identifier understood by the frontend; not a provider-side theme setting.

themeColor.description: Custom six-digit hexadecimal accent color. The frontend must retain legible light/dark contrast.

coverPhotoId.description: Photo ID belonging to this gallery, or null to use the default cover.

externalUrl.description: Optional HTTPS Zonerama profile or album URL. When present, no photo files are copied into the public export.

Gallery.description: Saved owner-facing album; owner reads include drafts. Public manifests are separately generated from deliberate publication snapshots.

sport.description: Owner-provided sport label; no automatic sport inference is claimed.

location.description: Owner-provided venue or location; GPS is not automatically reverse-geocoded.

eventDate.description: Owner-provided album date. ISO 8601 date or date-time; EXIF has no reliable timezone when none was recorded.

coverPhotoId.description: Photo ID belonging to this gallery, or null to use the default cover.

externalUrl.description: HTTPS Zonerama destination for a curated external gallery, or an empty string for locally hosted photographs.

publishedAt.description: Last deliberate publication time, null for an unpublished album. ISO 8601 date or date-time; EXIF has no reliable timezone when none was recorded.

createdAt.description: Creation time. ISO 8601 date or date-time; EXIF has no reliable timezone when none was recorded.

photoCount.description: Owner-visible photo count. Public photo count must refer to the last published snapshot.

cover.description: Cover photo when available, otherwise null.

Photo.description: Saved original and locally prepared derivative metadata, without raw EXIF or filesystem paths. Publication chooses a snapshot of photo IDs; upload alone does not publish.

id.description: Immutable photo ID; URLs remain stable.

fileName.description: Original display filename, not a trusted filesystem path.

dateTaken.description: Per-image capture date or clearly identified fallback. ISO 8601 date or date-time; EXIF has no reliable timezone when none was recorded.

capturedAt.description: Local ingestion time; does not substitute for capture time. ISO 8601 date or date-time; EXIF has no reliable timezone when none was recorded.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original bytes; downloads must reproduce these bytes.

thumbnailUrl.description: Private local media URL in owner mode or immutable derivative path in the separately exported static manifest.

previewUrl.description: Locally optimized preview URL, not the original-quality download.

originalUrl.description: Unmodified-original URL; draft originals must not appear in public manifests/output.

hasGps.description: Whether original GPS metadata was detected. False is not a guarantee that every possible sensitive tag was audited.

metadataSource.description: Capture-date provenance such as manual, EXIF, last-modified or unavailable; actual enum vocabulary is not established here.

PhotoUpload.description: One multipart photo per request. Batch upload consists of bounded client requests with per-file progress, retry and cancellation.

photo.description: Exactly one original image, unmodified; maximum 104,857,600 bytes (100 MiB). Decoder-supported JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, or TIFF; first frame only for multi-frame images.

sport.description: Optional explicit photo sport; never inferred from pixels.

date.description: Optional explicit date override. The manager resolves an individual override before an explicit batch override; omission preserves this photo’s own EXIF date, then its own lastModified fallback.

lastModified.description: Optional browser file.lastModified timestamp in milliseconds, serialized as a multipart text field. Only a fallback; not evidence of capture date.

MetadataInspectionRequest.description: Transient multipart image inspection; no persistent photo or gallery record is created.

photo.description: Exactly one original image, unmodified; maximum 104,857,600 bytes (100 MiB). Decoder-supported JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, or TIFF; first frame only for multi-frame images.

lastModified.description: Optional browser file.lastModified timestamp in milliseconds, serialized as a multipart text field. Only a fallback; not evidence of capture date.

MetadataInspection.description: Detected metadata for owner review, not sport/location inference or a complete privacy audit.

dateTaken.description: This file’s own detected/fallback date. ISO 8601 date or date-time; EXIF has no reliable timezone when none was recorded.

camera.description: Detected camera description, when available; transient inspection only.

PublicationRequest.description: Deliberate acknowledgement before publication. Local-photo albums publish current photo IDs; Zonerama-backed albums publish only their curated external link.

ExportRequest.description: Empty object used by exportSite(); no provider credentials or deployment target are accepted.

ExportResult.description: Completed local static output. Not a hosted URL or confirmation of deployment.

outputPath.description: Private local absolute output directory; never copied into public data.

fileCount.description: Complete output asset count, including code, manifests, images and originals.
